summary: Fresh independent verification passes AC1–AC12 on the current repository state. The prescribed unit, lint, production build, complete and isolated Playwright, WebP decode, hash/size, formal-art, JSON, proof-structure, and deadline-carl gates all pass. Independent visual review covers all four contact sheets, current route/ending/save/combat evidence, the repaired four-viewport home surfaces, and additional read-only 1920x1080 plus 844x390 battle/CG/ending checks. No production or evidence gap remains.

criteria.reason: The typed manifest enumerates exactly 56 formal assets across four categories. Fresh unit/static audits, 64-file decode/hash checks, complete runtime matrices, and production browser tests confirm existing paths, unique hashes, successful requests, runtime reachability, and no forbidden token in any formal key/path/alt; rg candidates are confined to non-art fallbacks, legacy CSS typing, negative tests, proof screenshots, and SVG MIME handling.

Fresh unit and public-UI browser coverage confirm all 30 character-state keys with no missing runtime entry. Independent inspection of the contact sheet and representative originals confirms stable identities, clothing, palettes, silhouettes, readable state changes, usable transparency, and no release-blocking watermark, text, anatomy, costume, or crop defect.

The production suite freshly reaches all seven scene CGs and nine unique ending CGs through public UI with no missing keys or diagnostics. The 16-cell sheet and runtime frames are distinct, narratively aligned, consistently styled, and unstretched; supplemental 1920x1080 and 844x390 checks keep representative CG and ending subjects readable with zero overflow.

Three unique formal UI artworks render at all four contract viewports. Fresh browser assertions pass control reachability, no overflow, fixed-header hit testing, non-overlapping settings groups, scroll-bottom reachability, focus-visible behavior, and preserved states/content; visual inspection confirms a coherent tomb/gu dark-Chinese language and readable panels.

Fresh browser runs observe all six player effects before the enemy response, with continued turns, request-abort fallback, and reduced-motion recovery. Source inspection confirms 520 ms normal and 120 ms reduced phases. Supplemental 1920x1080 and 844x390 checks measure effect z-index 4 below dialogue 5 and controls 7, pointer-events none, bounded images, and readable opposing directions.

art-generation.json has 56 unique records, exactly one adopted ImageGen output per record, 56 unique adopted output IDs, complete prompts, allowed post-processing, inspections, and 56 retained originals. Independent review of all four contact sheets and representative originals finds coherent semi-realistic dark Chinese-fantasy art without a decisive watermark, generated text, modern object, anatomy, alpha, or narrative defect.

Fresh ImageMagick verification decodes all 64 release WebPs. The formal audit passes 56 unique hashes, class dimensions/alpha/byte limits, and 5,165,122 total bytes; independent grouping finds zero duplicate SHA-256 groups. Fresh browser evidence reports one homepage image request totaling 33,040 bytes with no eager matrix preload.

Fresh browser suites pass four viewports, deterministic screenshots, overflow, 844x390 settings scrolling/hit testing, portrait prompt, focus, contrast, touch targets, and reduced motion. Independent screenshot review plus supplemental 1920x1080 and 844x390 gameplay runs show no overflow, clipped primary control, stretch, or release-blocking obstruction.

The fresh 16-test production suite passes all four routes, seven required nodes, and nine endings through public UI against the newly built out/ export. Runtime matrices contain 30/30 character and 16/16 CG entries with no missing key, and captured pages identify the active scene/ending and mapped asset.

Fresh unit and production browser coverage passes six-slot manual behavior, quick save/load, return-to-menu reload, version-6 missing-visual-metadata compatibility, scene/battle/resource restoration, all required actions/effects, degradation, reduced motion, and victory/failure flows without changing frozen combat or save semantics.

All current-state gates pass: pnpm test 98/98, pnpm lint, pnpm build with fresh out/index.html, pnpm test:e2e:run 16/16, isolated visual-art Playwright 5/5, and proof:visual:static for 56 unique assets and four contact sheets. No test was skipped or weakened.

evidence.json parses, all fixed proof paths exist, the refreshed manual review is consistent with the fb24808 evidence state, scripts/validate-task-proof.mjs reports PASS, and deadline-carl reports valid=true with no missing file or schema error. Criterion statuses, commands, paths, and gaps are complete and internally consistent.
